scientific_integrity.external_premise_disclosed: Sharp Radon Birkhoff arithmetic-chord bound A_2^B≤3/2 and hexagon equality, Qi–Yin–Liu (2026) Eq. (23).
scientific_integrity.priority_caveat: No guarantee that an older equivalent convex-majorization or Radon-plane result is absent.

scientific_limitations: Real two-dimensional Radon normed planes and finite power-mean orders t≥1 only. Relies on the published sharp Radon arithmetic-chord inequality and its equality characterization. No stability for almost-maximizers, no classification of all maximizing pairs, and no publication-priority certification. The full text of a related 2025 arithmetic-chord paper was not available through lawful open-access routes.
title: Sharp high-order Birkhoff–Takahashi envelope for Radon planes
